findings.summary: F1 (blocking): no drift guard bound a sentence to the ledger reason it paraphrases -- review PROVED it by mutating a ledger reason to an opposite ruling while every guard stayed green. Fixed: each sentence digest-pinned to sha256 of its exact ledger reason; the mutation probe now breaks the suite (verified on three domains).

F2-F4, F6 (blocking + recommended): four sentences overclaimed against source -- Home's unconditional inclusion, connection_records presupposing inclusion, ai_proposals' closed enumeration omitting real destinations, community 'will include'. All corrected and re-verified truthful.
F5 (blocking): domain_summary's docstring asserted verbatim-only reasons above the mapping that softens them. Rewritten honestly.

F7: jargon canary widened -- underscore package forms, usp_ names, internal vocabulary, snake_case identifiers, V-numbers, 'domain matrix', 'reader'. All 18 final sentences pass; six of the reviewer's seven leak examples are caught.

F8: the frozen completion report asserted independent review in the past tense before any review existed -- in the truthfulness package. Corrected with the correction itself recorded, not silently rewritten.

F9/F10: three wording notes taken (drop invented 'search'; 'this part of PeerSlate'; 'operational data about how the service runs') plus the cosmetic dash fix; included-domain-with-leftover-mapping now fails the suite.

Final verdict on the wording: 18 truthful, 0 overclaims, 0 underclaims, per the reviewer's per-sentence verdict table recorded verbatim in the package evidence as the owner's veto-reading artifact. The owner has not personally read all 18; his veto stands.

Honest limit: the digest pin detects LEDGER drift, not SENTENCE drift -- a future sentence edit passes the pin silently. Acceptable because any sentence edit is a Protected-surface change that gets its own review, but recorded aloud.
Honest limit: the canary still passes some internal vocabulary ('V1 domain matrix' patterns are now caught; other terms may exist). It is a tripwire, not a proof of plain language.
